verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents orchestrating transformations in the destination, run automatically after the connection syncs they depend on or on a schedule, so there is sequencing between ingestion and downstream transformations. The evidence does not show a general way to declare dependencies between arbitrary pipeline steps and datasets. missing for 10: user-defined cross-pipeline/dataset dependency graphs, ordering across multiple connectors and transformations, documentation of how dependencies are declared, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I define dependencies between pipeline steps and datasets, and the platform orchestrates runs in the right order

citations.quote: Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
Orchestrate pre-built and custom data transformations in your destination with Fivetran.
Use the Fivetran-hosted dbt Core integration or our third-party dbt Cloud and Coalesce orchestration to centralize and manage all your transformations.
